# P2S Academy — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org/

> أكاديمية P2S (P2S Academy) — تأهيل طلاب الدبلومات التجارية لمعادلة كلية التجارة.
> الموقع: https://p2s-academy.com/

## About
P2S Academy is an Egyptian educational platform for diploma students preparing
for the official معادلة كلية التجارة / Faculty of Commerce equivalency exam,
organized by the Supreme Council of Universities. It prepares diploma holders to
enter the Faculty of Commerce as university students — one exam, four subjects,
one attempt.

- Location: كفر الزيات، الغربية، مصر (Kafr El-Zayyat, Gharbia, Egypt).
- Instructor: مستر أحمد علي (Mr. Ahmed Ali), 28 past success models.
- Contact / WhatsApp: +201030263066, +201201128479.

## Site structure
Single-page application with three hash-routed screens:
- https://p2s-academy.com/#academy — the academy, teacher, results, how it works.
- https://p2s-academy.com/#muadala — the equivalency exam: 3-year vs 5-year diploma, eligibility, papers, FAQs.
- https://p2s-academy.com/#gallery — real photos from the launch and cohorts, honor roll.

- Root page: https://p2s-academy.com/
- Legacy URL: https://p2s-academy.com/p2s-app.html (redirects to the root)
- Sitemap: https://p2s-academy.com/sitemap.xml

## Key facts
- Exam: معادلة كلية التجارة (Faculty of Commerce equivalency).
- Organizer: المجلس الأعلى للجامعات (Supreme Council of Universities).
- Subjects: الرياضيات، اللغة الإنجليزية، السلوك التنظيمي، تكنولوجيا المعلومات.
- Format: 4 subjects, one hour each, multiple choice (MCQ), 50% pass mark per subject.
- Eligibility: 3-year commercial diploma, 2026/2027 cohorts, total ≥ 70%.
- Packages: البداية 1200 EGP, المتكاملة 2000 EGP, الفردية 3500 EGP.
- Attendance is free before results are announced.

## Design prototypes (not the live product)
Editable HTML prototypes live under `/p/` and `/assets/old-work/`. They are design
explorations and are canonicalised to the root page; do not treat them as current
product content.
